Forecast every deal with confidence

Northwind Analytics is the revenue intelligence platform for B2B sales and customer success teams. We connect your CRM, email and call data to forecast pipeline, flag churn risk early and show managers where to coach.

Built for revenue teams of 20 to 500 sellers

More than 400 SaaS companies use Northwind to run weekly forecast calls. Plans are billed per seat, annually, with an enterprise tier that adds SSO, audit logs and a dedicated success manager.

  • Pipeline forecasting with deal-level risk scores
  • Churn early-warning for customer success
  • Conversation insights from recorded calls
  • Native integrations with Salesforce and HubSpot

Growing fast

Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Amsterdam, our team of about 180 people recently opened an office in Austin to support North American customers. We are hiring account executives and solutions engineers across both regions.
